idea: A local coordination tool for hospital operations teams to track discharge equipment requests without storing patient records
answers: Hospital discharge coordinators and equipment managers at multi-site health systems. They lose hours reconciling equipment requests across email and spreadsheets. The first test is a workflow interview, not clinical advice.
results: For this disposable acceptance scenario, I interviewed five hospital operations managers; two agreed to review a workflow prototype. These are supplied test inputs, not verified market evidence.
